init.title: ČEZ Dynamic Tariff options
init.description: Schedules use comma-separated `HH:MM=price change in %` items and must start at `00:00`. Add or remove an item to add or remove a band. Default thresholds are -50, -10, +10, and +25 %. The +25 % modifier occurs in the default workday schedules; default weekend/holiday schedules do not use it. Thresholds classify modifiers and do not change a schedule.

data.include_holidays: Treat Czech public holidays as weekend/holiday

data_description.cheap_threshold: Above the super cheap threshold and at or below this value is cheap. Default: -10 %.
data_description.super_cheap_threshold: At or below this value is super cheap. Default: -50 %.
data_description.expensive_threshold: From this value up to the very expensive threshold is expensive. Default: +10 %.
data_description.very_expensive_threshold: At or above this value is very expensive. Default: +25 %.
data_description.reset_schedules: Discard all custom times and price modifiers and restore the project defaults.
data_description.winter_workday_schedule: Complete schedule. The default +25 % bands start at 05:00 and 18:00. Each next start ends the previous band.
data_description.winter_offday_schedule: Complete schedule. The default weekend/holiday schedule has no +25 % band, but one can be added, for example 12:00=+25.
data_description.summer_workday_schedule: Complete schedule. The default +25 % bands start at 05:00 and 18:00. The number of bands can be changed.
data_description.summer_offday_schedule: Complete schedule. The default weekend/holiday schedule has no +25 % band, but one can be added. The last band ends at midnight.
